reasoning: The icon shows a diamond-shaped road sign containing a right-turn arrow struck through by a diagonal slash (directions off / navigation disabled). Because the slash obliterates the arrowhead and corner of the turn, the graphic is hard to read at small sizes and fits only a narrow slice of tasks about disabling or troubleshooting turn-by-turn navigation.

qa.fix: A diamond road sign with a turn arrow, struck through: directions/navigation off. NFC disabled (listed first) is not what is drawn.
